column2: WARNING Wastewater Wet Well Sign – Hydrogen Sulfide Can Pool And Deaden Smell – 8x12 Aluminum
column3:
Hydrogen Sulfide Can Pool And Deaden Smell. This WARNING Wastewater Wet Well sign from CGAP Safety reads: WASTEWATER WET WELL / HYDROGEN SULFIDE CAN POOL LOW / AND DEADEN YOUR SENSE OF SMELL / TEST ATMOSPHERE BEFORE ENTRY. Written for wastewater treatment plants, lift stations, municipal utilities.

Why this sign matters

Hydrogen sulfide is heavier than air and collects in the bottom of the well, and at higher levels it numbs the sense of smell so the rotten egg odor fades while the danger rises.

Where to post it

On the wet well hatch frame or the rail beside it, facing the person who opens the hatch.

Who orders it

Wastewater plant superintendents and collection system supervisors.

Rust-resistant .065 aluminum, UV-resistant print, pre-drilled in all four corners. Made in the USA. Related standards to review for your site: OSHA 1910.146; ANSI Z535.2. A sign supports your safety program; it does not replace guarding, lockout or training.

On the outside of the lift station control panel door, next to the hand-off-auto selectors.
